review_candidates.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer (all genders)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Die BGO Holding GmbH ist eine internationale Unternehmensgruppe bestehend aus den drei Büromöbelherstellern Bene, hali und Neudoerfler und der BGO Montage & Logistik GmbH mit österreichischen Wurzeln . Rund 1.300 Mitarbeiter:innen arbeiten an drei hochmodernen Produktionsstandorten in Österreich . Wir arbeiten proaktiv an der Arbeitswelt von morgen. Stellenbeschreibung DEIN TEAM: Ist motiviert und gespannt welche Projekte auf uns warten. Ist humorvoll und kommunikativ – Spaß kommt bei uns nicht
eligibility_evidence: Die BGO Holding GmbH ist eine internationale Unternehmensgruppe bestehend aus den drei Büromöbelherstellern Bene, hali und Neudoerfler und der BGO Montage & Logistik GmbH mit österreichischen Wurzeln .

Qualifikationen DEINE MISSION: Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten IT-Infrastruktur in hybriden Cloud- und On-Premises-Umgebungen, insbesondere Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Virtualisierung, Storage, Backup & Recovery, Microsoft 365 und Modern Workplace Sicher

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Expleo benefits from more than 50 years of experience developing complex products in automotive and aerospace, optimizing manufacturing processes, and ensuring the quality of information systems. Responsibilities Within the Network Operations department, you will be part of the Production Services organization, responsible for the shared IT infrastructure that supports customer-facing services. The team is responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and operating network infrastructure
eligibility_evidence: You will work within an international network team, collaborating closely with colleagues across several European countries.
Experience working in multi-site, multi-data-center, or international enterprise environments.
What Do I Need Before I Apply Hybrid, a few days per month at the office.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Expleo benefits from more than 50 years of experience developing complex products in automotive and aerospace, optimizing manufacturing processes, and ensuring the quality of information systems. Leveraging its deep sector knowledge and wide-ranging expertise in fields including AI engineering, digitalization, automation, cybersecurity and data science, the group’s mission is to fast-track innovation through each step of the value chain. Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with enterprise routing and switching, including VXLAN, subnetting, IP networking, DHCP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, VRF, NAT, and routing/switching protocols. Strong hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls, preferably Check Point. Experience with standards, compliance, and operational processes, including ITIL-style incident/change/problem management and security/regulatory requirements.
